column1: # Meshpunk P4 partition map (16MB flash) — PROVISIONAL (Phase 0 of
# docs/P4_PORT_PLAN_2026-10-12.md). One factory app slot + the data
# filesystem under the same "assets" label the S3 firmware mounts. The app
# slot is 6 MB until the first firmware build reports its size (the S3 dev
# image is 3.0 MB in a 5.5 MB slot; Arduino 3 + IDF 5 add to that). The
# OTA/updater layout is a later decision and will replace this file.
